findings.affected: Greyhounds (ID 28), EuroLeague/NBA (ID 4), Snooker (ID 8), Tennis (ID 3), Handball (ID 20), Motor Racing (ID 14)
findings.summary: OLBG server renders UTC-4 (US Eastern Daylight Time) strings across UK/European events without timezone labels.
findings.evidence: Event 689388 is titled '11:14 Kinsley' (11:14 BST = 10:14 UTC) yet displays 'Today 06:14' right beside the title; event 534889 ('SAC Kings @ LA Clippers', 02:30 UTC Oct 22) displays 'Today 22:30' next to 'SAC Kings (2:30am)'.
findings.resolution: Every fixture in data/fixtures.json stores a canonical ISO-8601 UTC value linked to a governing-body source; any unconfirmed UTC is left blank and flagged.

findings.affected: Gaelic Football — Rathgormack v The Nire (event_id=3536)
findings.summary: OLBG schedules the Waterford Senior Football Final a full week late on '01 Nov 10:30'.
findings.evidence: Official Munster GAA championship fixtures schedule Rathgormack v The Nire for Sunday 25 Oct 2026 at 14:30 GMT/UTC at Fraher Field, Dungarvan.
findings.resolution: Corrected to 2026-10-25T14:30:00Z in data/fixtures.json and flagged on row gaa-waterford-3536.

findings.affected: Basketball — Hapoel Bank Yahav Jerusalem v Rigas Zelli (event_id=535918)
findings.summary: OLBG lists BKT EuroCup/BCL club tie under 'EuroLeague' tournament header.
findings.evidence: Official EuroLeague Basketball feeds confirm neither Hapoel Jerusalem nor Rigas Zelli is a 2026-27 EuroLeague club; the fixture belongs to European secondary competition.
findings.resolution: Reclassified accurately under BKT EuroCup with a tailored 168.5-point European total line.

findings.affected: Basketball — Golden State Warriors @ Los Angeles Lakers (event_id=534888)
findings.summary: OLBG hub summary card promotes 'Under 234.5' despite zero tips on that market on the event page.

findings.resolution: Recorded true Moneyline consensus and flagged upstream cache desynchronisation.

findings.summary: An independent post-integration audit found tactical prose that was not represented in the stored source facts arrays.
findings.evidence: The review page records the historical issue and examples; the generated text is now limited to each fixture's two stored, source-linked input values plus the explicitly labelled model selection.
findings.resolution: Re-authored all 31 predictions from the versioned official-input fields; unsupported tactical, injury, lineup and performance claims were removed. The source freshness boundary remains separately flagged.

findings.affected: Primary snapshot: 136 source-linked events
findings.summary: The fixture data contains 130 Verified rows and 5 Cross-checked Gallagher Premiership rows; public summary wording must preserve that split.
findings.evidence: Premiership fixture rendering was client-side during the stored verification work, so those five rows were deliberately not promoted to Verified.
findings.resolution: Dashboard, README and audit manifest now use '136 source-linked events (130 Verified; 5 Cross-checked)' instead of flattening all rows to Verified.

findings.affected: All primary fixture source links
findings.summary: The final integration gate validates recorded URL authority, data structure and static output; it does not make live network requests during validation.
findings.evidence: A valid recorded source link is auditable provenance, not a guarantee that a remote publisher has not later changed its content.
findings.resolution: The exact per-row source URLs are published in the Final Integration Audit. Any later discrepancy must remain blank/flagged until a governing-body source is re-opened and compared.

findings.affected: All 136 rows
findings.summary: 52 rows were re-confirmed and 7 corrected against official pages in this pass; 6 carry a time conflict, 1 is unconfirmed, 16 are blocked by a gated publisher and 54 were not re-fetched and remain prior-session provenance.

findings.resolution: Nothing was upgraded on the strength of an earlier note. Rows that were not re-fetched are labelled 'not re-checked' wherever they appear, rather than being called verified.
